scripts.build: npm run build -w @coretta/shared && npm run build -w @coretta/chain && npm run build -w @coretta/db && npm run build -w @coretta/api && npm run build -w @coretta/web && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:landing: npm install --prefix apps/landing --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix apps/landing
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @coretta/shared && npm run build -w @coretta/chain && npm run build -w @coretta/db && npm run build -w @coretta/api && npm run build -w @coretta/web
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run lint --prefix apps/landing
scripts.test: npm run build -w @coretta/shared && npm run build -w @coretta/api && node --test tests/authorization.test.mjs tests/damian-memory.test.mjs && node --require ./tests/tsx-preload.cjs ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --tsconfig apps/landing/tsconfig.json --test tests/damian-intent.test.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,landing -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @coretta/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/landing"
